ddl.name: quests_reminders_due_idx
ddl.where: ((("quests"."deleted_at" is null)) and (("quests"."completed_at" is null)) and (("quests"."shelved_at" is null)) and (("quests"."accepted_at" is not null)) and (("quests"."accepted_by" is not null)) and (("quests"."reminder_interval" is not null)))

ddl.name: quests_holds_due_idx
ddl.where: ((("quests"."deleted_at" is null)) and (("quests"."held_at" is not null)) and (("quests"."held_until" is not null)))

ddl.name: quests_open_idx
ddl.where: ((("quests"."deleted_at" is null)) and (("quests"."completed_at" is null)) and (("quests"."shelved_at" is null)))
